title: Renting and moving
focus: 租房 · 房租 · 房东 · 搬家 · 装修 · 中介 · 押金 · 水电费
body:
Finding a flat, dealing with the landlord and moving in. Sentences bring back 转账 from L20, 让步 from L17 and the money words from L9.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 租房 | zūfáng | to rent a place (as a tenant) | rent + house → to rent |
| 房租 | fángzū | rent (the monthly payment) | house + rent → the payment |
| 房东 | fángdōng | landlord | house + east (host's seat) |
| 搬家 | bānjiā | to move (house) | carry your home elsewhere |
| 装修 | zhuāngxiū | to renovate / decorate (a home) | fit out + repair |
| 中介 | zhōngjiè | agent / agency (real estate) | the one in the middle |
| 押金 | yājīn | deposit (for a rental, refundable) | pledged money → deposit |
| 水电费 | shuǐdiànfèi | utilities (water and electricity bills) | water + power + fee |

## Which word?

**租房 vs 房租:** same two characters, flipped. 租房 (verb first) is the action, to rent a place; 房租 (noun) is the monthly payment.

## Sentences

- 在上海租房，房租差不多占收入一半。 zài Shànghǎi zūfáng, fángzū chàbuduō zhàn shōurù yíbàn: If you rent in Shanghai, the rent takes almost half your income.
- 房东又要涨房租了，真无奈。 fángdōng yòu yào zhǎng fángzū le, zhēn wúnài: The landlord's raising the rent again. Nothing we can do.
- 搬家那天，Ollie躲在床底下不出来。 bānjiā nà tiān, Ollie duǒ zài chuáng dǐxia bù chūlai: On moving day, Ollie hid under the bed and wouldn't come out.
- 通过中介租房，还得多付一个月房租。 tōngguò zhōngjiè zūfáng, hái děi duō fù yí ge yuè fángzū: If you rent through an agent, you pay an extra month's rent.
- 房东不肯让步，押金一分都不退。 fángdōng bù kěn ràngbù, yājīn yì fēn dōu bú tuì: The landlord won't budge and won't return a cent of the deposit.
- 押金和水电费都转账给房东了。 yājīn hé shuǐdiànfèi dōu zhuǎnzhàng gěi fángdōng le: I've transferred the deposit and the utilities to the landlord.
- 楼上在装修，吵得我失眠了一个星期。 lóushàng zài zhuāngxiū, chǎo de wǒ shīmián le yí ge xīngqī: Upstairs is being renovated, and the noise has kept me awake for a week.
- 房子还在装修，我们只能推迟搬家。 fángzi hái zài zhuāngxiū, wǒmen zhǐ néng tuīchí bānjiā: The flat is still being renovated, so we have to push back the move.

cards.English: to rent a place (as a tenant)
cards.Example: 我在公司附近租房住。 wǒ zài gōngsī fùjìn zūfáng zhù: I rent a place near my office
cards.Notes: 租 zū rent, 禾 grain: rent was once paid in grain + 房 fáng house (房子, 房间) = rent a house. 出租 = rent out (出租车 = taxi, a car for hire); 房租 flips it: the rent itself

cards.Example: 这边房租一个月多少？ zhèbiān fángzū yí gè yuè duōshao: How much is rent here per month?
cards.Notes: 房 fáng house + 租 zū rent (禾 grain: rent once paid in grain) = the house's rent. Flip of 租房 (to rent a place). 交房租 = pay rent

cards.Example: 热水器坏了，得找房东修。 rèshuǐqì huài le, děi zhǎo fángdōng xiū: The water heater broke, I need the landlord to fix it
cards.Notes: 房 fáng house + 东 dōng east = the host of the house: in old etiquette the host took the east side, guests the west (hence 做东 = to host, 东道主). Tenant = 房客 (house guest) or 租客

cards.Example: 下个月我们要搬家，东西还没收拾。 xià gè yuè wǒmen yào bānjiā, dōngxi hái méi shōushi: We're moving next month and haven't packed yet
cards.Notes: 搬 bān move, carry, 扌 hand (搬东西) + 家 jiā home = carry your home somewhere else. 搬家公司 = moving company

cards.Example: 楼上在装修，每天吵死了。 lóushàng zài zhuāngxiū, měitiān chǎo sǐ le: Upstairs is renovating and it's deafening every day
cards.Notes: 装 zhuāng fit out, install (安装, 装饰) + 修 xiū repair (修理, 修车) = fit out and fix up. 精装修 = finely done, move-in ready; 毛坯房 = bare shell, unfinished

cards.Example: 通过中介找房要交中介费。 tōngguò zhōngjiè zhǎo fáng yào jiāo zhōngjièfèi: Finding a place through an agent means paying a fee
cards.Notes: 中 zhōng middle + 介 jiè between, introduce (介绍) = the one in the middle who introduces both sides. 房产中介 = real estate agency

cards.Example: 租房要交两个月押金。 zūfáng yào jiāo liǎng ge yuè yājīn: Renting needs two months' deposit
cards.Notes: 押 yā pledge, pawn, 扌 hand (抵押) + 金 jīn money (现金) = pledged money, so a refundable deposit. 押金 = refundable deposit; 定金 (定 settle) = down payment that secures a deal.

cards.Example: 房租不包水电费。 fángzū bù bāo shuǐdiànfèi: Rent doesn't include utilities
cards.Notes: 水 water + 电 diàn electricity (电话, 电视) + 费 fèi fee, 贝 shell = money (学费, 小费) = water and power fees. 包水电 = utilities included; 燃气费 = 燃 burn + 气 gas: gas bill

cards.Notes: 租房 (L21) + 房租 (L21) + 收入 (L9). 占 = take up (a share).

cards.Notes: 房东 (L21) + 房租 (L21) + 无奈 (L7). 涨房租 = raise the rent.

cards.Notes: 中介 (L21) + 租房 (L21) + 房租 (L21). 多付 = pay extra.
